# KitchenReport

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Stats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class KitchenReport
```

The `inspect` listing for a Kitchen: what the workspace folder actually holds, grouped by kind.

Lives here beside [`IdentityReport`](Nfty.Core.Stats.IdentityReport.md) and [`CollectionReport`](Nfty.Core.Stats.CollectionReport.md) for the same reason they do — a front-end that re-derived "something similar" would drift from this one the first time either changed. The GUI has no Kitchen listing yet; when it grows one it shows these bytes rather than its own approximation.

Paths are printed as bare file names, not as the absolute paths [`KitchenContents`](Nfty.Core.Formats.KitchenContents.md) carries. The folder is named once at the top, so repeating it on every row would bury the only part that differs, and a listing full of machine-specific absolute paths cannot be pasted into an issue.
